description: Fetch one node's relationships from Microsoft Graph as a nodes/edges delta. Dimensions for a user node: org (manager chain + direct reports), groups (memberships), access (directory roles + app assignments), attributes (pivot hub for attr). For nodeType group/role, returns members. For nodeType attribute pass attr+value to load the whole cohort. The delta is returned to the caller only — it does not update an open polyarchy canvas (the UI fetches its own data when the user interacts with it).

attr.description: Attribute name or nested path, e.g. department or onPremisesExtensionAttributes/extensionAttribute9

nodeId.description: Entra object id (users, groups, roles); a UPN also works for users

name: polyarchy-expand
title: Expand polyarchy node
